mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, business_goal, department, priority, status, budget, safety_index_target, actual_safety_index, metrics_json, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, is_deleted FROM #{schema}.ecos_scenario_definition WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, name, description, business_goal, department, priority, status, budget, safety_index_target, actual_safety_index, metrics_json, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, is_deleted FROM #{schema}.ecos_scenario_definition WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM #{schema}.ecos_scenario_definition WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO #{schema}.ecos_scenario_definition (id, name, description, business_goal, department, priority, status, budget, safety_index_target, actual_safety_index, metrics_json, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_deleted, version_no, domain) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.name}, #{row.description}, #{row.businessGoal}, #{row.department}, #{row.priority}, #{row.status}, #{row.budget}, #{row.safetyIndexTarget}, #{row.actualSafetyIndex}, #{row.metricsJson}, #{row.createBy}, NOW(), #{row.updateBy}, NOW(), 0, 0, #{row.domain})
mapper.update: UPDATE #{schema}.ecos_scenario_definition SET status = #{status}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW(), version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE #{schema}.ecos_scenario_definition SET is_deleted = 1, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT s.id FROM #{schema}.ecos_scenario_definition s WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM #{schema}.ecos_scenario_asset_binding b WHERE b.scenario_id = s.id AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.is_island = TRUE )
